description: About Niantic Spatial AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time. That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are. In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right. Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us. About the Role You’ll join our Research Team in London as a 3D Reconstruction Research Scientist/Engineer — working at both ends of the pipeline, from cutting-edge academic research to shipping directly to customers. Our team builds the reconstruction technology that turns casually captured or domain-specific imagery into high-fidelity 3D reconstructions: everything from Structure-from-Motion through 3D Gaussian Splatting, feed-forward models, and generative models. We’ve shipped 360 splatting to consumers and enterprise customers, developed the splatting tech that runs on phones, and published at CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, and SIGGRAPH — more often than not, our papers end up in production. You’ll work alongside world-class researchers in computer vision, machine learning, graphics, and robotics on large-scale spatial understanding, localization, reconstruction, scene understanding, and geospatial foundation models. This role is open to junior and senior researchers; scope and responsibility are calibrated to your experience. What You’ll Do Research & Publication — Conduct original research in 3D computer vision, machine learning, and spatial AI; publish findings at top-tier venues including CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, and SIGGRAPH. Algorithm Development — Design, implement, and evaluate novel algorithms across 3D reconstruction, neural scene representations, 3D Gaussian Splatting, SfM, meshing, geometric deep learning, feed-forward models, generative models, and spatial foundation models. Research-to-Production — Collaborate with research scientists and engineers to transition promising ideas into customer-facing products — working directly with real capture conditions, real hardware constraints, and real customers on short turnarounds. Large-Scale Experimentation — Build and run large-scale experiments and benchmarking frameworks to rigorously validate and advance new methods. Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration — Partner with world-class researchers in CV, ML, graphics, and robotics to advance large-scale spatial understanding, localization, reconstruction, and geospatial foundation models. Rapid Prototyping — Implement and iterate on state-of-the-art methods for both academic publishing and production deployment, delivering working prototypes to enterprise customers with speed and quality. What You’ll Bring PhD in Computer Vision, Robotics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a closely related field — or equivalent demonstrated research experience in industry. A strong research track record in 3D computer vision: reconstruction, depth estimation, novel view synthesis, SfM, SLAM, or closely related areas. A meaningful publication record at top-tier venues (CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, SIGGRAPH, NeurIPS, or equivalent). Strong programming skills in Python and hands-on experience with PyTorch. Evidence that you can carry an idea from research into something real — a shipped feature, a production pipeline, a widely used open-source release, or similar. The independence to drive research projects from idea generation through experimentation, publication, and handoff. Nice to Have Experience with classical reconstruction tooling (COLMAP or similar). C++ or CUDA experience, and a feel for performance and on-device constraints. Experience with traditional 3D techniques — meshing, texturing, or bringing modern geometry or generative representations into native 3D. Compensation & Benefits Base salary: Competitive market rate. Compensation also includes an annual bonus, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package. Location & Work Model This role is based in our London office, with three days per week in office. Inclusive Application We know the strongest candidates don’t always tick every box. If you’re excited about this role and believe you could do it well, we encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn’t match every qualification listed — you may be exactly who we’re looking for. description: Our Mission At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails, and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved. We’ve raised $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, and Accel to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility. The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it. We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for. Our team previously scaled Tessian (cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel, acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben, Abs, Sabrina, and Rebe. Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here. The Role As an AI Deployment Lead / Applied AI Consultant, you'll work directly with our most strategic customers to understand their objectives and key challenges, identify high-impact AI opportunities, and translate them into measurable business value. You'll be building AI solutions on Omnea's procurement automation platform, combining the structured data flowing through requests, approvals, contracts, and supplier records with AI. Omnea gives AI the operational context of how a business actually buys, so it can move past answering questions and start taking action inside procurement itself: routing requests, flagging risk, drafting contract terms, negotiating with suppliers. There is no AI without that context. You'll prototype these solutions, demonstrate their value to executives, and ensure successful implementation, adoption, and value realisation, growing Omnea's footprint at those customers as you go. This customer-facing role is ideal for people who enjoy working directly with customers and turning complex business challenges into practical AI solutions. The focus is on problem framing, solution design, and business impact rather than pure implementation. While you will prototype AI solutions, the primary goal is to deliver meaningful business value to customers. What You'll Do Identify High-Impact AI Opportunities: Work closely with enterprise customers to understand their strategic priorities and operational challenges, identifying where AI can deliver measurable business value. Design AI-Powered Solutions: Translate complex business problems into scalable solution architectures, using Omnea's AI to eliminate manual work across procurement. Prototype and Demonstrate Value: Rapidly build prototypes and proof-of-value solutions that demonstrate tangible outcomes to business and technical stakeholders. Lead AI Innovation with Customers: Facilitate workshops, hackathons, and innovation sessions with customers to explore new ways AI can transform their operations. Drive Adoption and Business Impact: Partner with customer teams to ensure successful implementation, adoption, and realisation of measurable value from AI deployments. Develop Domain Expertise: Build deep expertise in specific industries or business domains (e.g., supply chain, finance) and help scale that knowledge across the organisation. What's Different About This Role You'll spend more time on problem framing and validation than on hand-building every proof of value. AI can generate a working prototype fast; your job is deciding whether it actually solves the customer's problem. Writing a sharp brief for what you want AI to build is now core to the role, not a side skill. Judgment on business impact matters more than raw build speed: which use case actually moves the metric the customer cares about, and which is just an impressive demo. You'll keep pushing on what's possible as Omnea's AI tooling evolves, and bring what you learn back to the rest of the team. About You You might be a great fit if you… have 5+ years of experience in solutions consulting, data / AI consulting, technical pre-sales, sales engineering, value engineering, or customer-facing solution-architecture or AI roles enjoy translating business challenges into technical solutions can communicate complex technical concepts to business and executive stakeholders have a good understanding of business processes across procurement, finance, and supply chain, with the ability to translate high-level business needs into specific AI use cases demonstrate strong presentation skills to both internal and external stakeholders (including executives), whether whiteboarding sessions or formal readouts and demos know how to measure the business impact of what you've delivered, and can turn that into a clear story for stakeholders - time saved, error rates down, adoption up, whatever the metric that actually matters to that customer have hands-on experience identifying, designing, and building automations or AI-driven solutions for repeatable processes, not just scoping them on paper At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out. A few things to note: We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here. We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

We are looking for an Analytics Engineer to join our Revenue, Purchase & Order Analytics Engineering team.

The area sits at the heart of some of the most critical customer journeys and commercial systems across Vinted’s Marketplace Business Unit, spanning Revenue (pricing and advertising), Purchase (inquiries and checkout), and Orders (transactions and fulfilment). Together, these domains create a rich, high-volume, and deeply interconnected data ecosystem.

As an Analytics Engineer, you’ll work at the intersection of data, engineering, and product, building trusted data products that power business and product decision-making across these domains.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Build scalable data products: Design, develop, and evolve reliable, cost-efficient data products and pipelines that power analytics and machine learning use cases across the domains.
  • Build quality in by design: Embed automated testing, validation, and quality controls throughout the data lifecycle to ensure data remains accurate, consistent, and complete.
  • Strengthen observability: Improve monitoring and alerting to detect and address issues before they impact downstream consumers.
  • Own production reliability: Take end-to-end ownership of production data systems, from investigating incidents and diagnosing root causes to implementing durable fixes that prevent recurrence and improve long-term resilience.

Who you’ll work with:

  • Revenue, Purchase & Order Analytics Engineering: Join a talented and driven team of 7+ Analytics Engineers, working across interconnected domains and tackling complex, high-impact data challenges.
  • Data & Decision Scientists: Work closely with Data Scientists and Decision Scientists to build trusted data foundations that enable better business and product decisions.
  • Engineering, Product & Business: Partner with Backend Engineering, Product, and Business teams to understand their needs, shape technical requirements, and translate them into well-designed, trusted data solutions.
  • The Analytics Engineering Guild: Be an active member of Vinted’s 40+ member AE Guild, benefiting from shared tooling, engineering standards, and knowledge across domains. You’ll also have opportunities to contribute to “side quests” that improve engineering practices, tooling, and reusable capabilities.

About you 

  • Experience working as an Analytics Engineer, Data Engineer, or in a closely related data role.
  • Strong SQL and data warehousing fundamentals, with the ability to build clean, performant, and maintainable data solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with dbt or a similar data transformation framework, building well-structured and tested data models.
  • Experience working with a cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or similar.
  • A solid understanding of data modelling principles and their application to real-world analytical problems.
  • Familiarity with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, Dagster, or similar.
  • Comfortable working with high-volume, business-critical data, balancing a high bar for quality and reliability with a pragmatic bias for action.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to clearly explain technical concepts and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per working day
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
  • NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport
  • Company bike leasing scheme
  • Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform
  • Work from Home allowance [[DELETE FOR Breda, Utrecht, Amsterdam Store]]
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work 

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

€53.900—€72.900 EUR

About Summit:

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

  • HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

  • HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

  • HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

  • HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.

Job Title: Sr. Medical Science Liaison

Location: Oxford, UK or Zug, Switzerland or Dublin, Ireland

 

Overview of Role:

The Associate Director, Clinical Supply Management supports the Senior Director in leading the full scope of global clinical supply chain responsibilities. The role translates functional strategy into disciplined execution across demand and supply planning, inventory management, packaging and labelling, distribution, returns and destruction, cross-border compliance, and GxP operations. Acting as a key delegate for the Senior Director, the (Associate) Director provides a layer of management for direct reports, establishes clear priorities and performance expectations, develops team capability, and drives operational excellence through standardized processes, meaningful metrics, proactive risk management, and continuous improvement. The role partners closely with Clinical Operations, Commercial, CMC, Quality, Regulatory, Finance, Legal, Procurement, Medical Affairs and Program Management, and oversees external partners including Contract Development and Manufacturing Organizations (CDMOs), IXRS providers and specialist service providers.

 

Role and Responsibilities:

  • Supports the Senior Director in developing functional strategy, operating plans, budgets, governance and performance objectives across global clinical supply chain activities
  • Leads day-to-day execution for new and ongoing studies and products, ensuring robust forecasting, supply planning, schedule adherence, inventory optimization, global logistics and sustained GxP compliance
  • Serves as a delegate for the Senior Director in cross-functional forums, governance meetings, supplier reviews and issue escalation, providing clear recommendations and ensuring timely follow-through.
  • Manages and develops direct reports, translating functional priorities into individual objectives, balancing workloads, coaching performance, supporting career development and ensuring appropriate succession and capability plans.
  • Creates an effective management layer by coordinating team activities, reinforcing accountability, removing operational barriers and escalating material risks or decisions to the Senior Director.
  • Overseeing the Clinical Supply Management (CSM) team, the Associate Director interprets complex clinical protocols, development plans and commercial demand forecasts, working with CMC and internal and external partners to develop packaging, labelling, supply and resupply strategies, timelines and plans.
  • Supports the accountability of CSM team to oversee packaging, labelling, release, distribution, resupply, returns, reconciliation and destruction activities across global locations
  • Develops and maintains supply project budgets, resource plans and integrated schedules, monitors performance and proactively resolves variances
  • Manages CDMO and service-provider activities from RFP and contracting support through routine operations, troubleshooting, invoicing and performance management using defined KPIs and service expectations
  • Supports IXRS selection, design, set-up, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), implementation and ongoing operational performance as required by IRT Management Team.
  • Drives operational excellence by defining standard work, governance routines, KPIs and dashboards; uses trend and root-cause analysis to improve service, quality, cost, compliance and team productivity
  • Leads continuous-improvement initiatives that streamline and harmonize processes, strengthen inspection readiness and embed sustainable ways of working
  • Supports regulatory submissions, audits and inspections and ensures timely management of SOPs, change controls, deviations, investigations and CAPAs within the function
  • Provides continuity of leadership and performs other responsibilities within the function as assigned

 

Experience, Education and Specialized Knowledge and Skills:

  • BSc, MSc, engineering or pharmacy degree, or equivalent, with a minimum of 8+ years of progressive supply chain experience in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology or contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) environment
  • Demonstrated success leading complex international clinical studies and product supply chains, with broad knowledge of regulatory and GMP requirements for IMP and commercial product packaging and supply
  • Prior people-management experience, including setting objectives, coaching performance, developing talent, delegating effectively and managing through others
  • Demonstrated ability to translate strategy into executable priorities, operating rhythms, metrics and measurable team outcomes
  • Strong operational-excellence and continuous-improvement capability, including process standardization, KPI management, root-cause analysis and sustainable implementation of improvements
  • Solid understanding of IXRS design specifications, set-up and UAT, together with proficiency in clinical supply planning and forecasting tools
  • Strong project, budget, risk and resource-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high-quality results
  • Expertise in outsourcing, supplier governance, negotiation and performance management
  • Experience building, scaling or improving end-to-end product supply chains and associated business processes
  • Ability to operate as a trusted deputy to the Director, exercise sound judgement within delegated authority and escalate issues with clear options and recommendations
  • Confident communicator able to influence all levels of the organization and build effective relationships with global colleagues, customers and suppliers
  • Able to work independently with complex global problems while fostering inclusion, collaboration, accountability and effective team leadership
  • Agile and resilient in a dynamic organization where priorities may change rapidly
  • Knowledge of the drug development process and applicable FDA, EMA and PMDA expectations, including GMP, GCP, Annex 13 and relevant clinical trial requirements
  • Technically proficient with industry-standard systems and tools and able to use technology, data and industry trends to improve efficiency and decision-making
  • Knowledgeable of and compliant with SOPs, change controls, deviations, investigations and CAPAs

This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible.  
 
Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. As Associate Director, Medical Advisor, EU West, you will report to the Medical Director EU West and provide scientific leadership for three rare-disease launch programs in achondroplasia, limb-girdle muscular dystrophy, and genetic hypocalcaemia. You will translate global strategy into a focused country medical plan, build trusted partnerships across the French rare-disease ecosystem, and ensure high-quality, compliant execution in an agile affiliate environment. The main focus will be France.

Responsibilities

  • Medical strategy and execution: Co-develop and execute the France Medical Affairs plan for the three portfolio programs, with clear priorities, milestones, KPIs, resource needs, and budget assumptions

But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. Location: Paris

At this time, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are committed to building a diverse, global team and our sponsorship policy is evaluated on a role-by-role basis. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship.

Please submit your application in English. 


Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today's challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


What will I be doing?

In this role, you will be a key driver of our mission to reimagine energy and make net-zero a reality for everyone. As a Customer Enablement Specialist, you will be the bridge between our innovative technology and the people who use it. You will empower our clients, partners, and colleagues in French-speaking markets to not only understand our platform but to master it - including the AI-powered capabilities we are continuously building and rolling out. Your work will directly accelerate Kaluza's growth by ensuring our users are confident, capable, and ready to support the energy transition.

Strategic Training & Programme Partnership: Act as a trusted advisor to our clients, partners, and internal teams, performing deep learning needs analysis to understand their unique operational challenges. You'll manage your workstream with genuine project and programme management discipline - planning, sequencing and tracking delivery within complex, multi-stakeholder client programmes, ideally drawing on agile ways of working to stay responsive as scope evolves.

Content Creation & Delivery: You will be the master of making the complex simple. You'll create high-quality, engaging training materials in both French and English, including interactive workshops, e-learning modules, and quick reference guides - translating not just today's platform, but AI features and products still in development, into training that's ready the moment they go live. You'll deliver these sessions virtually and in-person, inspiring your audience and building their confidence with every interaction.

Driving Adoption & Impact: Your role is to accelerate the adoption of the Kaluza platform. You will provide post-training support and coaching, monitor the effectiveness of your programmes, and continuously iterate based on feedback and performance metrics. You'll ensure our training leads to real-world, positive change for our users and the energy industry.


About You 

Ideally you’ll have/be

  • Bilingual Fluency, to a high standard: You are fluent in both French and English, with outstanding written and spoken communication skills - essential for day-to-day stakeholder management across multiple countries, up to and including executive level.
  • Operational & Technical SaaS Training Expertise: A proven track record designing and delivering training in a SaaS or technology environment, ideally with hands-on experience of operational or technical instructional training rather than generalist L&D delivery.
  • Project & Programme Management Experience: Strong project and/or programme management experience gained within complex, multi-stakeholder environments; experience of agile delivery is a strong advantage.
  • Operational Experience: Demonstrable experience gained within an operational environment - energy sector operations and/or contact centre settings are especially valued - giving you a first-hand understanding of the pressures and workflows your training needs to support.
  • AI Fluency: Demonstrable experience building, productionalising, or delivering training on AI features and products while they are still in development, and genuine confidence working with AI tools as part of your own everyday practice.
  • Simplification Master: You possess a natural ability to take complex technical and business concepts and translate them into clear, engaging, and practical learning materials.
  • Engaging Facilitator: You are a confident and dynamic presenter, able to captivate diverse audiences and create a fun, interactive learning environment.
  • Collaborative & Proactive: You are a team player who builds strong relationships and is proactive in identifying opportunities to support others and drive continuous improvement.

What will set you apart 

  • Energy Sector Acumen: A practical background in energy utility operations or decarbonisation technologies, beyond the operational experience above, that lets you connect training directly to the real-world challenges our clients face.
  • Proven Training Leadership: A demonstrated track record of scaling training programmes and an ability to think strategically about how to build and expand a learning culture across an international organisation.


Where you'll work

We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.


Kaluza Values

Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business: 

Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together.


Our Perks

  • Financial & Insurance: Discretionary bonus, Alan Mutuelle Health Insurance, x3 Life & Death insurance (Prévoyance) via Alan, and standard Sécurité Sociale contributions (pension, family allowance, unemployment insurance)
  • Allowances: 50% commuting expense reimbursement, €200 Home Working Allowance, and €150 Learning Fund

We want the best people

We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.

We understand some people may not apply for jobs unless they tick every box. But if you're excited about joining us and think you have some of what we're looking for, even if you're not 100% sure, we'd still love to hear from you.

Find out more about working in Kaluza on our careers page and LinkedIn.

Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees. We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You will design and operate scalable batch/streaming data pipelines, harden platform orchestration, and ensure system reliability, security, and cost efficiency. A central challenge of this role is building and operationalizing our unified healthcare data ontology—a consistent semantic model covering hospitals, departments, specialties, metrics, and classification standards. Working closely with Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, and Methodology experts, you will turn heterogeneous, multi-country hospital data into a coherent, highly queryable data asset. Data Contracts & Schema Governance: Establish strict data contracts (Pydantic, dbt contracts) and schema management, ensuring dataset reproducibility, data lineage tracking, and automated validation across all platform pipelines. Platform Efficiency & Cloud Infrastructure: Optimize data storage, query execution, and compute costs across AWS and Snowflake, keeping data assets performant, secure, and cost-effective. Automation & CI/CD: Implement automated testing and deployment workflows for data pipelines using GitHub Actions and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform). Cross-Functional Data Enablement: Partner directly with Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, and domain experts to deliver documented, research-grade, and production-ready datasets. Qualifications Core Requirements (Must-Haves) Data Ingestion & Pipeline Orchestration: Advanced Python and analytical SQL for complex data ingestion across diverse file formats, REST APIs, databases, and cloud lakes (S3/Iceberg). Hands-on experience with modern orchestrators (Prefect, Airflow, or Dagster). Entity Resolution & Data Governance: Practical experience with entity resolution/record linkage frameworks (e.g., Splink, dedupe, recordlinkage) and schema management/data contracts (Pydantic, dbt contracts, or JSON Schema). Cloud Platform & Warehouse Infrastructure: Deep hands-on experience in an AWS production environment (S3, ECS/EC2) combined with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake). Automated CI/CD & Workflow Automation: Proven track record of automating data pipeline deployments, integration tests, and validation workflows via GitHub Actions. Nice-to-Haves (What Will Make You Stand Out) Knowledge Graphs & Healthcare Terminologies: Exposure to ontology/semantic frameworks (RDF/OWL, SKOS, Neo4j, LinkML) or international medical classifications/vocabularies (SNOMED CT, ICD/OPS, FHIR). Metadata & Lineage Tooling: Experience operating metadata registries and lineage catalogs (e.g., OpenMetadata, DataHub, dbt docs). Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Proficiency in using Terraform to declaratively manage cloud resources and environments. Your Profile Degree: Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related quantitative field. Experience: 3+ years in data engineering building production pipelines and data platforms; including a sustained period within one organization seeing a core platform or product through build → launch → iteration. Domain Knowledge: Healthcare domain experience is a plus (basic understanding of healthcare KPIs, quality metrics, or benchmarking concepts; familiarity with hospital structures and medical classification systems like ICD/OPS is especially valuable). Mindset: Strong analytical and systems mindset, with a proven ability to transform messy, heterogeneous international data into a clean, well-governed, and highly structured data asset. Languages: Fluent in English, German is a plus. Working Style: Highly structured, curious, detail-oriented, and motivated to collaborate closely with analytics engineers, data scientists, and methodology experts in an international environment. description: About Mirakl: Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy. Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus). With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways. For more information, visit www.mirakl.com. Mirakl in Numbers: 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo Our Values: Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique. Our 5 values guide how we collaborate: 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success 🏆 Get Things Done: We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results 🚀 Go Above & Beyond: We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success About the role Mirakl is looking for a senior contractor to join its Finance team and provide operational leadership in an international, multi-entity environment. Reporting to the Accounting & Tax Director, you will secure the continuity and quality of day-to-day accounting operations while supporting the monthly and annual close. The role also offers the opportunity to contribute to the transformation of the Finance function, particularly through the identification, testing and adoption of relevant automation and AI use cases. The successful candidate will combine strong accounting expertise with a pragmatic, hands-on approach to process improvement and change management. Contractor 6 months Start: ASAP Location: Paris or Bordeaux (aller-retour à prévoir à Bordeaux 1 fois par mois) Key responsibilities Accounts Payable and Procure-to-Pay Own and coordinate the end-to-end Procure-to-Pay process, from supplier creation and invoice receipt through to validation, booking and payment. Coordinate the Accounts Payable team and ensure timely processing of invoices across Mirakl's entities. Monitor invoice workflows, approvals, purchase orders, blocked invoices and outstanding supplier balances. Review invoice coding, supporting documentation and accounting treatment, and act as an escalation point for complex supplier issues. Coordinate payment runs and ensure that payment files are prepared accurately and in line with internal approval procedures. Maintain robust controls over vendor master data, bank details, payment approvals and segregation of duties. Accounting operations and close support Support the Accounting & Tax Director in the coordination of the monthly and annual close process. Review AP-related cut-off and other accounting entries. Monitor the reconciliation and clean-up of relevant balance sheet accounts and support the review of intercompany transactions. Coordinate with local accounting firms and external service providers across Mirakl's international perimeter. Contribute to audit preparation and respond to requests from external auditors and other stakeholders. Ensure that accounting evidence, procedures and control documentation are complete, accessible and up to date. Finance transformation, automation and AI Contribute to Mirakl's Finance AI transformation roadmap by identifying high-value use cases within AP, Procure-to-Pay and accounting operations. Participate in discovery phases, workshops and experiments aimed at improving invoice processing, data quality, reconciliations, reporting and operational support. Help assess and test AI-enabled workflows, automation solutions and Finance agents, working closely with Finance, Data and other stakeholders. Translate operational requirements into clear process, data and control requirements for automation and AI initiatives. Support the adoption of new tools by documenting processes, defining operating guidelines, monitoring results and helping teams embed new ways of working. Remain attentive to data quality, confidentiality, traceability, human oversight and appropriate controls when using AI in Finance processes. Candidate profile 8+ years of experience in accounting, finance operations or accounting management Previous experience as an Accounting Manager, Deputy Accounting Director Experience in a multi-entity, international environment; experience in a fast-growing technology or SaaS company is a strong advantage. Solid understanding of accounting principles, closing processes, cut-off, reconciliations and internal controls. Experience working with external accounting firms and international subsidiaries. Strong knowledge of ERP and finance systems Interest in Finance transformation, automation and AI, with the ability to translate operational needs into practical use cases. Autonomous, hands-on and solution-oriented, with excellent organisational, analytical and communication skills. Fluent English required; French is a strong advantage. We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations. As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: Job Title: Design Operations Lead Location: London, Hybrid (3 days in office) About Gen: We're not just a company; we're a global force. Fiercely committed to ensuring that everyone, everywhere, can live their lives digitally safe. Our family of brands, Norton, Avast, LifeLock, Avira, AVG, ReputationDefender and CCleaner, unite the brightest minds, the sharpest tech and the most diverse thinking to protect over 500 million people. And we've built an inclusive workplace, where your well-being is a priority because true success comes from a place of balance and authenticity. When you're thriving, you're unstoppable. So, bring us your bold ideas and passion that refuses to quit. The digital world isn't some distant reality, it's the world we live in, and we're ready for it. If you're ready to push boundaries and be part of something bigger, join #TeamGen. How We Work: Our hybrid work style (3 days in the London office) gives us the face-to-face time to have creative conversations, meaningful meetings, make quick decisions and build relationships. And it's flexible enough to give you the space to do your best work. About the Role: As a Design Operations Lead you will support the day-to-day operations of Gen's global product design organisation. You will work alongside product designers, researchers, design leaders, and cross-functional partners to improve the workflows, tools, and systems that help teams do their best work. You will bring structure to planning, delivery, handoffs, reviews, and team rituals. By making ways of working clearer and easier to scale, you will help the design organisation operate with greater visibility, consistency, and focus and help teams deliver better outcomes for our customers. About the Team: You will be part of a global product design organisation working across Gen's family of digital safety brands. The team brings together product designers, researchers, design leaders, and cross-functional partners who collaborate to solve meaningful problems for people navigating the digital world. Design Operations sits at the centre of this network, helping teams connect their plans, tools, rituals, and documentation so that creative work can move forward with less friction. Key Responsibilities: Drive and facilitate core planning and collaboration cadences, including sprint planning, milestone reviews, retrospectives, and design critiques Identify and implement workflow and process improvements, including automation, documentation, and tooling strategies that improve visibility and reduce friction Partner with design leads to create clear timelines, milestone plans, and delivery checkpoints that support accountability and informed decision-making Own and evolve project-tracking systems such as JIRA and Figma ensuring they remain useful, current, and aligned to team needs Maintain team documentation, briefs, review records, and other operational resources so that information is easy to find and act on Create structure around design handoffs, stakeholder reviews, and team rituals to empower designers and improve cross-functional collaboration Support continuous improvement through feedback loops, retrospective facilitation, and structured iteration on processes and ways of working About You: You are a thoughtful organiser who understands that strong operations should enable great design, not get in its way. You are comfortable bringing clarity to complex work, coordinating across different perspectives, and improving processes in a fast-moving environment. You have a genuine appreciation for design and can build trust with creative, technical, and business partners. Education: a degree or equivalent practical experience in design operations, UX, project or programme management, business, or a related field. Experience: 5-7 years of experience in design operations, UX programme coordination, project management, or a related role Experience supporting a design, research, product, or similarly collaborative team in a complex organisation Experience improving workflows, planning cadences, documentation, or operational systems Experience working with modern design and delivery tools, including Figma, JIRA, ClaudeCode Skills: Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams and levels of seniority Excellent organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and follow through on commitments Strong planning, facilitation, and project coordination skills Ability to analyse how work gets done, identify friction, and turn improvements into practical, repeatable ways of working Confidence learning and managing tools, systems, and documentation practices that support design teams Personal Attributes: Curious, pragmatic, and motivated by continuous improvement Collaborative and relationship-oriented, with a calm and constructive approach Proactive and dependable, with strong ownership of details and follow-through Adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-moving, global environment Passionate about creating the conditions for designers and partners to do their best work Benefits: At Gen Digital, we are committed to supporting our employees' well-being and professional growth. Our comprehensive benefits package for UK team members includes: Health & Wellbeing: company-paid private medical insurance, dental and vision benefits, plus access to mental health and wellbeing support through our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) Financial Security: a Group Personal Pension Plan with auto-enrolment for eligible employees, together with the opportunity to purchase Gen stock through our Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) Unlimited Paid Time Off: available once statutory annual leave has been used, plus company holidays and a range of leave options to support personal and family needs Tuition Reimbursement: up to £5,150 per calendar year for job-related accredited courses that support career development within Gen Wellness Reimbursement: up to $450 per year to cover fitness-related expenses Sustainability Allowance: a $500 annual sustainable home improvement allowance Additional Perks: access to adoption assistance, family support services, legal assistance plans and exclusive employee discounts What's Next: Your CV will be reviewed by the recruiter and hiring manager to understand the scope of your work, the impact you've delivered, and how your experience aligns with the role. If shortlisted, the recruiter will be in touch to set up a conversation to learn more about your background, what's motivating you, why you're interested in Gen and our products, and to go through the interview process. Gen is an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to fair, inclusive practices at every stage of the candidate and employee journey. Employment decisions are based on merit, experience and business needs. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. The Role We are looking for a hands-on Senior Mechanical Engineer to join our engineering team in Lausanne. You will handle the end-to-end design, numerical simulation, and physical validation of specialised mechanical and electromechanical structures to optimize system performance and match hardware capabilities to demanding operational requirements. From day one, you will take ownership of mechanical architectures and physical assemblies. You will run non-linear explicit finite element simulations, build high-precision CAD models, set up lab and range tests, and see designs through to production and final delivery. What You Will Do Structural & Dynamics Simulation: Run non-linear explicit finite element simulations to build predictive models for structural integrity, dynamic impact, vibration response, and high-velocity mechanical behavior against extreme physical operational environments. CAD Design & Drafting: Create and maintain complex CAD models, structural housings, mechanisms, and technical drawings for production release. Empirical Testing & Data Capture: Write R&D test specifications for environmental, drop, structural, and shock testing. Source specialized testing equipment, manage range and lab setups, and analyze sensor data to validate simulation accuracy. Cross-Functional Integration: Work directly with multidisciplinary engineering teams to advise on physical constraints, payload optimization, spatial layouts, and mechanical integration parameters. Safety & Hazard Assessments: Conduct system-level hazard analyses and safety evaluations for critical mechanical mechanisms and energetic system interfaces. Production & Field Support: Document hardware performance guidelines, assist with first-production validation, optimize designs for manufacturing processes, and provide technical support during end-user demos and customer engagements. What We Are Looking For Background: B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Applied Physics, or a related technical discipline. Simulation Expertise: Hands-on experience with non-linear explicit finite element analysis applied to high-velocity mechanical impact, dynamic loading, shock waves, and material failure models. Mechanical Systems Knowledge: Deep understanding of mechanical hardware, structural mechanics, tolerance stack-ups, thermal dissipation, and dynamic load transfer. R&D Range & Lab Testing: Practical experience setting up, executing, and analyzing data from physical prototype testing, environmental chambers, dynamic test tracks, or field evaluation programs. CAD & Manufacturing: Solid proficiency in standard CAD software for complex assembly design, mechanical drafting, and manufacturing processes like CNC machining, additive manufacturing, or injection molding. Drive & Ownership: Practical problem-solver who takes full responsibility for hardware deliverables and balances physical analysis with project timelines. What We Offer Direct exposure to high-performance mechanical design from early concepts through physical deployment. Regular opportunities to test and validate hardware in realistic operational test environments. Involvement with cross-functional technical teams and external stakeholders deploying mission-critical systems. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

description: We are the creators of Flipper Zero — a portable device for tech enthusiasts and engineers. It’s a gadget with an awesome community that brings together millions of people around the world. We’re building a new product — Flipper One. It’s a full-featured ARM-based computer running Linux in a compact form factor, powered by the Rockchip RK3576 SoC. We’ve decided to make the entire development process completely open and public. That’s why we’re looking for a Developer Portal & Community Manager to own and manage the entire Flipper One Developer Portal: maintaining the wiki, collecting tasks from all development teams, managing all GitHub projects and repositories, and proactively communicating with the community. This role is perfect for you if you want to be close to the product, see firsthand how it’s built, and help turn that process into a clear and valuable entry point for the community. This is not a “content manager” role — you’ll need to fully understand the development process, track all ongoing tasks, and connect the team with the community to make things happen. What is the Developer Portal? The Developer Portal is a public wiki + a set of GitHub projects built around Flipper One. It documents how the project works as a whole, explains the architecture of its major subsystems, and provides contribution guides for the community — showing how people can contribute to each sub-project. Anyone reading the Developer Portal wiki should come away with a complete understanding of the project structure, each feature, and what exactly we are building. Requirements: You write clearly, concisely, and without fluff, and can show examples of your work: guides, instructions, READMEs, how-tos, or similar materials Basic understanding of hardware, structure, logic, clarity, and information quality Genuinely interested in developer-facing products, hardware, documentation, open communities, and the build-in-public approach Proficiency in Russian and English for communication with other departments in the company and the external community Nice-to-have: Experience in DevRel, technical writing, community operations, or an editorial role Experience working with documentation, wikis, knowledge bases, or developer portals Understanding of the culture of technical communities, open-source, and hardware projects Ability to work across topics at the intersection of interfaces, electronics, product architecture, and internal development Responsibilites: Own and develop the Flipper One Developer Portal Turn the team’s internal context into clear public documentation, notes, updates, and explanations Join team calls to understand what’s actually happening in the project and maintain a complete picture of it Translate technical discussions into clear, human language without losing meaning or accuracy Moderate community comments, pull requests, and contributions Filter out spam, reduce noise, and keep discussions productive Help users understand how the portal works and how to provide useful feedback Collect signals from the community and bring them back to the team Make sure the portal stays structured, up to date, and description: About H: H Company is a next-generation AI research and product company pioneering the future of autonomous, agentic AI. Founded to build intelligence that acts, H Company is creating the foundational infrastructure for autonomous AI systems that drive real-world outcomes across industries. The Role Large enterprises find H through a referral, an event or a headline, and then they land on our website. Today that moment converts too little, and we can't fully measure it. Your mission is to make our website and online channels the first source of qualified enterprise pipeline for H, worldwide You will own H's online engine, as a senior individual contributor in the Growth pillar of our marketing strategy, alongside Brand and Product Marketing. You'll lead the redesign of our website with a web agency, own its performance and conversion, build our organic visibility on search engines and in AI answers (SEO and GEO), and steer our paid agency on LinkedIn, Google and other channels. Your focus is the enterprise funnel: C-level and IT decision-makers in large accounts, demo requests, and long sales cycles run with our Sales and FDE teams. Every choice you make is judged on one question: does it create qualified pipeline? You'll work hand in hand with the Brand Lead (identity), the Content Manager (words), Sales and RevOps (HubSpot), and our external web and paid agencies. What You'll Do Lead the website redesign (Foundations) Own the redesign of h.company end to end: brief, select and steer a web agency, from architecture and UX to build, launch and iteration. Set the site's technical standards: CMS, performance, accessibility, security, and a multi-market setup (France, UK, US) that scales. Own tracking, analytics and attribution, with a clean integration into HubSpot, so every visit, campaign and demo request can be traced to pipeline. Decide the platform, architecture and conversion choices; the Brand Lead owns identity, the Content Manager owns copy. Turn visitors into pipeline (Conversion) Design the journeys that turn enterprise visitors into qualified demo requests, by persona (C-level, IT and business leaders) and by use case. Run a continuous testing roadmap (A/B tests, landing pages, forms, demo flow) and decide what ships on evidence. Work with Sales and RevOps on lead qualification and routing, so the leads you generate are the ones Sales wants. Own our organic visibility (Organic: SEO & GEO) Lead technical and strategic SEO: site health, information architecture, keyword strategy on enterprise AI and automation topics, international SEO. Build our presence in AI answers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, AI Overviews): experiment, measure our share of voice, and turn what works into a method. Partner with the Content Manager on the content that ranks and gets cited. Steer paid acquisition (Paid) Own paid strategy and budget, and steer our paid agency on LinkedIn, Google and other channels (Reddit included, where it serves the funnel). Brief, challenge and arbitrate with a pipeline logic, not a click logic: cost per qualified lead, cost per opportunity, influence on target accounts. Support account-based campaigns on our priority enterprise accounts with Sales. Build the function Manage the digital budget and agencies (web, paid, freelancers). Report on performance monthly: traffic, conversion, organic and AI visibility, paid efficiency, pipeline generated. Use our own AI agents where they help, and test new tools before others do. What Success Looks Like in 6 Months The new website is live, fast, multi-market, and fully tracked from first visit to opportunity in HubSpot. Visitor-to-demo conversion has improved by [X], and the website is a top source of qualified enterprise pipeline. H ranks and is cited, on search engines and in AI answers, on our priority enterprise AI topics. Paid spend is measured against qualified pipeline, and cost per opportunity is under control. What We're Looking For 6+ years in digital marketing, growth or web, including for a B2B SaaS or tech company selling to large enterprises. You have led a website redesign end to end with an agency, and you can show what it changed in conversion and pipeline. You have strong technical SEO skills, and you are already experimenting with visibility in AI answers and measuring it. You have steered paid agencies on LinkedIn and Google with a B2B pipeline logic, and you know how to brief, challenge and arbitrate. You master analytics, tracking and attribution, and you are at ease with HubSpot. You are data-driven and hands-on: you build your own dashboards, read the numbers, and ship. Fluent English is required; French is a strong plus. You Might Be a Great Fit If... You have built the online engine of a company selling to large enterprises, with long cycles and a few high-value deals. You have run international SEO and sites across Europe and the US. You are curious about how AI changes search, and you want to be among the first to crack it. You care about proof: a test result or a pipeline number matters more to you than a vanity metric. You are low ego and high ownership, and you like building from the ground up. Location Paris, London hybrid: 3 days a week on average in our office. Occasional travel. What We Offer Join the early days of one of WW most ambitious AI companies, and build the engine that brings it its next customers. Real ownership: the website, organic and paid channels are yours, with a direct line to leadership. A playground few roles offer: an AI company where you can test AI search and our own agents first. A team of world-class researchers, engineers and operators who ship. Competitive salary and equity. Benefits: health insurance, meal vouchers, transport. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: ABOUT ROCKET LAB Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us. DIRECTOR – EUROPEAN GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS As the Director – European Government Operations, based in Munich/ Berlin, Germany, you will lead Rocket Lab's government affairs strategy across Germany and the broader European region. You will play a critical role in advancing Rocket Lab's business objectives by shaping policy environments, building strategic government relationships, and ensuring alignment between Government Affairs and Business Development. In this role, you will work at the intersection of aerospace innovation, national security, and European public-sector engagement. To be successful, you must be results‑oriented, proactive, politically astute, and deeply comfortable operating in complex, fast‑moving environments. Join a driven team of pioneers relentlessly tackling challenging projects, delivering on the impossible, and making an impact on the future of space. WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO Build and lead Rocket Lab's in‑house European Government Operations function, delivering the same level of strategic support and government engagement the company receives in the U.S. market Develop and lead Rocket Lab's government affairs strategy in Germany and across Europe, ensuring alignment with corporate priorities and business development objectives Build and maintain high‑impact relationships with key German federal stakeholders, including the Bundestag, DLR, Ministry of Defense, and relevant regulatory and executive agencies Establish and grow Rocket Lab's presence with government entities and innovation ecosystems in Munich and other strategic European hubs Partner closely with the Business Development team to support market expansion, customer engagement, and pursuit of government‑funded programs Shape and influence policy discussions related to space, defense, launch, and emerging technologies, ensuring Rocket Lab's interests are represented and understood Provide strategic guidance on political, regulatory, and industrial‑policy developments across Europe, identifying opportunities and risks for business Represent Rocket Lab in industry associations, working groups, and public‑sector forums to strengthen the company's visibility and credibility Drive measurable business outcomes through targeted government engagement not only monitoring policy trends but actively shaping them Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on European political dynamics, defense priorities, and government procurement pathways YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree in political science, international relations, public policy, law, economics, engineering, or a related field 12+ years of experience in government affairs, public policy, defense, aerospace, or related strategic roles within Germany or Europe Professional fluency in German and English Demonstrated success building and managing relationships with senior government officials, policymakers, and public‑sector institutions Proven ability to drive business‑aligned outcomes through government engagement, not solely policy monitoring Strong understanding of European political structures, defense priorities, and government procurement processes Ability to operate autonomously, set strategy, and execute in a fast‑paced, high‑growth environment Exceptional communication, negotiation, and stakeholder‑management skills THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE Background in space, aerospace, defense, or dual‑use technology sectors Experience working with or within institutions such as DLR, MOD, Bundestag committees, EU defense bodies, or national innovation agencies Prior roles in business development, defense industrial policy, or public‑sector consulting Experience working in Munich's government, defense, or technology ecosystem Familiarity with NATO, EU defense initiatives, and cross‑border industrial‑cooperation frameworks This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas. WHAT TO EXPECT We're on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that's not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other's backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way. description:
Mavericks Wanted 

When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on 
 
In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible.  
 
Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work. 

What You'll Do

You are a strategic IT partner with deep technical experience supporting BridgeBio's International organization across Commercial and Medical Affairs, G&A, and Supply Chain functions. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports: BridgeBio's operating model delivers International IT work through external vendors and consultants, and this role provides both the strategic direction and the hands-on technical expertise needed to design, direct, and validate that work. You report to the Executive Director, IT Enterprise Applications in the US, and partner closely with International business leaders and US-based IT counterparts.

You will own the International application and technology roadmap and business relationship, for Commercial and Medical Affairs systems including Veeva CRM, Databricks, and Analytics, while ensuring alignment with enterprise owned platforms managed by US teams. For core enterprise systems such as SAP S/4HANA, Coupa, Malbek CLM, and Workday HRIS, you will act as the International liaison, ensuring local business needs, regulatory requirements, and market nuances are represented in both strategy and system design. You will direct and technically oversee the consultants and partners who execute this work.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary strategic IT partner to International business leadership, aligning technology strategy with business priorities, operational objectives, and long-term growth plans
  • Shape and execute a multi-year technology roadmap for BridgeBio International, applying hands-on familiarity with Veeva CRM and data/analytics platforms (Databricks) to evaluate technical design decisions and identify digital transformation opportunities through data, automation, AI, and enterprise technologies
  • Own end-to-end demand management, prioritization, and delivery of International IT initiatives, including business case development and investment prioritization, ensuring alignment with business strategy and cross-platform standards, and monitoring performance through KPIs and value realization metrics
  • Own the technical design for International's Commercial and Medical Affairs applications, translating business requirements into detailed technical specifications and solution designs that external partners and consultants can execute against
  • Act as the International technical liaison for globally owned core systems (SAP S/4HANA, Coupa, Malbek CLM, Workday HRIS), partnering with US-based application owners on integration points, data flows, and localization requirements
  • Partner closely with US-based Enterprise Applications, Data & Analytics, Infrastructure, Security, and End User Services teams, aligning on platform governance, technical standards, and roadmap decisions for shared systems like Veeva CRM and Databricks
  • Direct and technically oversee external partners and consultants delivering International IT initiatives, since delivery capacity comes entirely through partners rather than an internal team: reviewing solution design, validating data integration approach and platform configuration, and holding vendors accountable to technical standards, timelines, and quality
  • Build trusted relationships across International business leadership and key stakeholders, acting as the primary advisor on technology strategy and digital innovation
  • Support platform expansion initiatives and pre- and post-product launch activities in key International markets, ensuring technology readiness, successful IT integration, and business continuity throughout the launch lifecycle
  • Identify risks, dependencies, and opportunities for process improvement across International applications, and propose pragmatic, business-aligned solutions
  • Ensure compliance with IT governance, cybersecurity, SOX, GxP, regulatory, and data integrity requirements while supporting audits and platform governance activities

Where You'll Work

  • This role is based in BridgeBio's Zug, Switzerland office
  • This is a hybrid role based in BridgeBio's Zug, Switzerland office, with an in-office collaboration cadence of 3 days per week

This is a compelling opportunity to join a high-impact, dynamic team as an individual contributor, shaping the IT roadmap and business strategy that help accelerate life-changing treatments for patients.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field required; advanced degrees preferred
  • 8+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry, including 5+ years in a hands-on technical architecture, solutions engineering, or senior IT management role supporting regional or international operations, with a successful track record supporting pre- and post-product launch activities in key International markets
  • Proven experience partnering with senior business leaders to define technology strategy and deliver measurable business outcomes, combined with deep, hands-on technical experience designing or architecting CRM platforms such as Veeva, and data management/analytics platforms such as Databricks
  • Strong understanding of Commercial and Medical Affairs IT, enterprise platforms, digital products, automation, data, AI, ERP environments (e.g., SAP, Coupa, Workday) sufficient to define integration and data requirements with US-based system owners
  • Experience leading complex technology portfolios and cross-functional programs within matrixed organizations, including experience directing the work of external vendors and consultants without a dedicated internal engineering team
  • Strong knowledge of regulated industries such as life sciences, pharmaceuticals, and biotechnology, including GxP, SOX, and data integrity requirements as they apply to system architecture
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and drive strategic decisions without direct authority, backed by excellent communication, consulting, and executive presentation skills that translate complex technology topics into business value
  • Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving capabilities, with experience evaluating technical trade-offs and building business cases for technology investments
  • Demonstrated experience managing vendors and consultants, including oversight of deliverables, timelines, and quality
  • Ability to travel up to 10% internationally

 

As a global company, our comprehensive benefits may vary based on location.  We have high expectations for our team members. We make sure those working hard for patients are rewarded and cared for in return.

For BridgeBio Full-Time U.S Based Roles:

Financial & Rewards  

  • Market-leading compensation   
  • 401(k) with employer match   
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)  
  • Pre-tax commuter benefits (transit and parking)  
  • Referral bonus for hired candidates  
  • Subsidized lunch and parking on in-office days  

Health & Well-Being  

  • 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision premiums for you and your dependents  
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions, plus Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)  
  • Fertility & family-forming benefits  
  •  Expanded mental health support (therapy and coaching resources)  
  • Hybrid work model with flexibility  
  • Flexible, “take-what-you-need” paid time off and company-paid holidays  
  • Comprehensive paid medical and parental leave to care for yourself and your family  

Skill Development & Career Paths: 

  • People are part of our growth and success story - from discovery to active drug trials and FDA pipelines, there are endless opportunities for skill development and internal mobility 
  • We provide career pathing through regular feedback, continuous education and professional development programs via LinkedIn Learning, LifeLabs, & BetterUp Coaching 
  • We celebrate strong performance with financial rewards, peer-to-peer recognition, and growth opportunities
