description:
Why Kimchi?

Great models are raw ingredients. Kimchi is what happens when you ferment them with good engineering. We started inside CAST AI helping companies run LLMs on their own Kubernetes clusters; today we run our own coding harness on any model you pick, and we run the models underneath it ourselves.

Kimchi Inference

One API line and a customer's existing client just works: DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax, Nemotron served serverless from our own GPU fleet (OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible, pay per token, spend visible per user, team, and key). When control matters, the same models run on the customer's own cluster instead. Behind that one line sits the machinery you'll own: SGLang and vLLM engines, B300 nodes, a shared cluster filesystem that holds every checkpoint exactly once, KV caches riding coding traffic with heavy prefix reuse, and the benchmark harness that gates every change we ship.

Made by Cast AI — a Miami-headquartered, globally distributed team across 34 countries that hit unicorn status in January 2026 with a $50B+ backed investment pushing its valuation past $1 billion.

About the role

Throughput. Latency. Cold starts. Cost per token.

Move those four numbers in the right direction and two things happen: customers get faster, cheaper inference, and our margins improve. That's the entire thesis of this role. Every loader you tune, every scheduler decision you land, every kernel you stare at shows up in a customer's p99 and on our P&L. Your mandate is the inference stack's optimization, whatever it takes, and the technical direction of how we optimize it is yours to argue with data.

The problem: the checkpoints run 0.3-1.5 TB, and the "right" serving configuration depends on traffic shape, sequence-length distribution, batch dynamics, GPU SKU, memory bandwidth, and quantization tolerance, all variables that shift week to week. Most teams pick a configuration once, over-provision GPUs, and absorb the cost. We don't: we took Kimi-K3 (1.5 TB) from over an hour cold-to-serving to under twelve minutes with a shared filesystem, O_DIRECT weight loaders, and node-local JIT caches, and we're nowhere near done. Prefill/decode disaggregation and tiered KV caches are next.

Stack: Python; SGLang; vLLM; TensorRT-LLM; PyTorch; fastsafetensors; CUDA-adjacent tooling; Kubernetes; virtiofs shared filesystems; ClickHouse; OpenTelemetry; Prometheus; Grafana; GitLab CI.

Requirements

  • You've built real ML systems for 5+ years, and your portfolio shows depth in inference or training infrastructure, not just model training notebooks.
  • Your Python is production-grade: services, not scripts.
  • You've run vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM for real, and you have a working mental model of why an engine performs the way it does on a given GPU.
  • You've measured quantization regressions, not just compression ratios.
  • Multi-GPU and multi-node setups hold no fear: tensor and expert parallelism, collective communication, and their practical failure modes.
  • You know where the bytes live (page caches, O_DIRECT, network filesystems under terabyte-scale reads) and how fast they move.
  • You instrument before you optimize, and you can tell a real win from a benchmark artifact.
  • A wide mandate excites you more than it unsettles you.

Nice to haves

  • You've worked on LLM routing specifically: RouterBench-class evals, cost/quality/latency Pareto fronts.
  • Calibration, abstention, or conformal methods in production decision systems.
  • You've run online A/B loops with drift monitoring on a model that touches real money.

Responsibilities

  • Push throughput. Continuous batching, chunked prefill, speculative decoding with draft models, CUDA-graph capture, and scheduler tuning across the engine
     fleet. Find the ceiling on each GPU SKU, then raise it.
  • Cut latency. Attack TTFT and inter-token latency separately; profile to find the actual bottleneck (compute, memory bandwidth, scheduling, storage, or
     network) and fix it, not the one you assumed.
  • Get more out of the KV cache. Hierarchical and paged attention, prefix caching on heavy-reuse coding traffic, eviction policies, quantized KV. A lot of the
     unrealized throughput lives here, and you'll own it.
  • Kill cold starts. Weight loaders (O_DIRECT, fastsafetensors-class), JIT and compile caches, shared-filesystem read paths. A 1.5 TB checkpoint has no business
     taking an hour to reach serving.
  • Quantize without regressing quality. INT8/INT4, FP8/FP4 across weights, activations, and KV, measured on real workloads, not just perplexity benchmarks.
  • Scale across nodes. Distributed inference topologies, network-aware placement, prefill/decode disaggregation, checkpointing strategies that don't bottleneck
     on storage or interconnect.
  • Set the technical direction. Decide what we benchmark, what we adopt, and what we build ourselves. Bring the team along with strong writeups and reproducible
     experiments.

What’s in it for you?

  • Competitive salary (depending on the level of experience).
  • Enjoy a flexible, remote-first global environment.
  • Collaborate with a global team of cloud experts and innovators, passionate about pushing the boundaries of Kubernetes technology
  • Equity options.
  • Get quick feedback with a fast-paced workflow. Most feature projects are completed in 1 to 4 weeks.
  • Spend 10% of your work time on personal projects or self-improvement. 
  • Learning budget for professional and personal development - including access to international conferences and courses that elevate your skills.
  • Annual hackathon to spark new ideas and strengthen team bonds.
  • Team-building budget and company events to connect with your colleagues.
  • Equipment budget to ensure you have everything you need.
  • Extra days off to help maintain a healthy work-life balance.

Hiring process

  • Screening call with Recruiter
  • Hiring Manager interview
  • Technical interview (system design)
  • Live coding
  • Culture Check interview with an executive

As part of our standard hiring process, we would like to inform you that a background check may be conducted at the final stage of recruitment through our third-party provider, Checkr.

Title: Senior RFP & Bid Manager, EMEA 

Location: Stockholm, Sweden; Aachen, Germany; Barcelona or Madrid, Spain; United Kingdom

Experience: Senior

Job Function: Revenue Operations

Employment Type: Full-Time

Industry: Computer and Network Security 

 

About the position

The Senior RFP & Bid Manager, EMEA is responsible for establishing, managing, and continuously improving the RFP, RFI, and tender response management framework across Keyfactor's EMEA sales organization. Operating as a specialized individual contributor, the role owns the operational processes, governance standards, tools, and knowledge management practices required to support effective and consistent bid responses.

The position coordinates the end-to-end RFP response process, working closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, and other relevant departments to obtain required inputs, manage timelines and dependencies, and facilitate accurate, complete, and timely submissions. The role applies specialized knowledge of bid management practices and procurement procedures to identify operational risks, recommend appropriate response approaches, and drive improvements in process effectiveness and efficiency. 

As part of a newly established function, the role develops scalable operating practices and documentation to support the continued development of RFP management capabilities within EMEA and potential future adoption in other regions.

This position can be based out of our offices in following locations and we have a hybrid work model: Stockholm (Sweden), Barcelona or Madrid (Spain), Aachen, Germany or United Kingdom.   

Responsibilities 

  • Own and continuously improve the EMEA RFP and bid management operating framework, establishing standardized intake procedures, response workflows, submission controls, and governance practices to ensure consistent and effective execution across the region.
  • Coordinate the end-to-end execution of complex RFP, RFI, and tender responses, working closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and other relevant functions to obtain required inputs, manage timelines and dependencies, and ensure timely, accurate, and complete submissions.
  • Develop and continuously improve bid management methodologies and standards, identifying operational inefficiencies, evaluating improvement opportunities, and implementing solutions to enhance response quality, turnaround time, and cross-functional effectiveness.
  • Apply specialized knowledge of public and private tender procedures, assessing procedural requirements, identifying submission risks, and providing guidance to internal stakeholders on appropriate response processes while escalating matters requiring legal, compliance, or commercial decisions to the relevant functions.
  • Establish and govern a centralized RFP content and knowledge management framework, including the administration of Loopio and approved supporting tools, ensuring content accuracy, consistency, currency, and appropriate validation by relevant subject-matter experts.
  • Facilitate effective cross-functional collaboration throughout the bid response process, coordinating contributions from Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product Management, Legal, Compliance, Finance, and Professional Services, and ensuring that dependencies, responsibilities, and escalation requirements are clearly communicated.
  • Exercise independent professional judgment in managing RFP response activities, determining when approved content can be used, identifying requirements for additional specialist input, and escalating complex or sensitive matters to the appropriate accountable stakeholders.
  • Coordinate the review and validation of technical, security, service-related, and contractual information included in bid responses, ensuring that product capabilities, roadmap statements, security representations, implementation commitments, and service deliverables are reviewed and approved by the relevant authorized functions prior to submission.
  • Serve as the primary operational point of contact for customer procurement representatives and external bid management partners, coordinating procedural clarifications, submission requirements, joint-bid activities, and response logistics while involving Sales and other relevant stakeholders in substantive customer discussions.
  • Develop and maintain RFP management performance reporting, monitoring submission volumes, turnaround times, response quality, content effectiveness, and relevant bid outcomes, analyzing operational trends, and recommending process improvements to Revenue Operations and Sales leadership.
  • Provide specialized functional guidance to internal stakeholders on bid management practices, supporting the consistent application of established workflows, tender procedures, governance standards, and RFP management tools across the EMEA sales organization.
  • Develop and maintain scalable bid management documentation and implementation playbooks, establishing repeatable methodologies and operating practices that support the ongoing development of the EMEA function and potential future adoption in other regions.

Minimum Qualifications, Education, and Skills 

Minimum Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

Minimum Knowledge & Job Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in RFP management, proposal management, bid management, or a closely related function, preferably within B2B software or technology environments.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating complex RFPs, RFIs, and tenders involving multiple internal functions and external stakeholders.
  • Proven experience establishing, improving, or governing structured bid response processes, including standardized workflows, content management practices, and operational procedures.
  • Strong working knowledge of public and private procurement processes, including open, restricted, negotiated, and competitive dialogue procedures.
  • Experience identifying procedural and operational risks and coordinating their resolution with relevant internal subject-matter experts.
  • Experience working with RFP management platforms and content repositories; experience with Loopio is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently prioritize RFP activities, manage competing deadlines, and determine when additional specialist input or escalation is required.
  • Experience collaborating with Sales, technical specialists, Legal, Compliance, and Professional Services in complex bid response environments.
  • Familiarity with B2B software environments; experience in cybersecurity, PKI, or information security is advantageous but not required.
  • Experience with Salesforce is preferred.
  • APMP certification or a comparable professional qualification is advantageous.

Minimum Skill

  • Strong bid and proposal project management skills, including planning, prioritization, stakeholder coordination, and deadline management.
  • Demonstrated process design, documentation, governance, and continuous improvement skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess procedural requirements, identify operational risks, and recommend appropriate solutions.
  • Excellent written communication and content review skills, ensuring accuracy, clarity, and consistency in customer-facing submissions.
  • Strong cross-functional stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to coordinate contributors without direct reporting authority.
  • Proficiency in RFP management tools, structured content repositories, and business productivity applications.
  • Ability to analyze operational performance data and translate findings into practical process improvements.
  • Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively across diverse teams and cultures within EMEA.

Minimum Abilities

  • Ability to work independently within broadly defined procedures, policies, and business objectives.
  • Ability to apply specialized knowledge and sound professional judgment to complex bid management activities.
  • Ability to establish and continuously improve operational processes in a developing functional environment.
  • Ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and manage dependencies while maintaining effective working relationships.
  • Ability to identify potential operational, procedural, and submission risks and determine appropriate escalation requirements.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders through specialized expertise, collaboration, and effective communication rather than formal organizational authority.
  • Ability to maintain accuracy, consistency, and attention to detail under competing deadlines.
  • Ability to adapt working methods and priorities to changing business requirements across EMEA.
  • Ability to distinguish operational decisions within the role's authority from matters requiring formal technical, legal, compliance, or commercial approval.

Travel Requirements

  • Up to 15% travel time required

We build teams that continually strive to get better than the day before. You will be challenged daily and given opportunities to grow personally and professionally. We balance autonomy and structure to create an entrepreneurial environment to spur creativity and new ideas.

  • Second Fridays (a company-wide day off on the second Friday of every month minus November and December due to the Holiday schedule). Please note that this benefit is subject to change.

description:
IDnow is a leader in digital identity and fraud prevention in Europe with a mission to transform trust into the most powerful asset in the digital world, empowering enterprises with AI-driven, SaaS-based identity solutions that deliver scalable security, adaptive compliance, and real-time fraud prevention. Through its broad portfolio of digital identity and fraud prevention solutions, IDnow establishes, maintains and enriches trust throughout the customer journey, ensuring businesses can confidently and securely operate while leveraging digital identity to drive growth, security and scalability.

The company has offices in Germany, United Kingdom, Romania and France, and is backed by renowned institutional investors, including Corsair Capital and Seventure Partners. Its portfolio of international clients spans a wide range of end markets including financial services, telecommunications, travel & mobility, gaming, and other industries.

 

 

This position is based in Rennes, France.

 

The Solutions Engineer at IDnow is the client's trusted advisor through pre-sales and integration. You design the solution the client will rely on, you give them confidence that it will work in their environment, and you become the person they turn to for technical and solution decisions. Your focus is the technical side of the journey up to the point where the client is live on our products, and you make that path smooth. 

This is a hands-on, deeply technical role, and a commercial one. Solutions Engineers carry a quota and are measured on two things: the deals they help win, and whether the client goes live successfully. You work hand in hand with Sales to convince the client that our solution is the right one and to move them toward signature, and then you make sure they can use it well in production. You earn that through technical depth, but you are client-facing, credible and persuasive in a sales motion. You do this across our whole client base.

We hire this role at more than one level. The core of the job is the same; the scope you own and the complexity you handle grow with your experience. This role carries real ownership across the client journey, and a say in how the work evolves.

 

Key Responsibilities

Discover and Design

  • Lead technical discovery, qualifying conversion rates, false acceptance and rejection trade-offs, fraud exposure and integration constraints before proposing a solution,
  • Design end-to-end solution architectures that orchestrate document verification, digital identity, fraud signals, biometric authentication, eID and EU Digital Identity Wallet flows, and e-signature,
  • Link every technical choice to the client’s business objectives and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), so proposals speak to outcomes rather than features,
  • Define defensible architecture decisions covering fallback logic, data residency, scalability and performance,
  • Support Sales with proposals, Requests for Proposal (RFPs) and Requests for Information (RFIs), advising on which capabilities to combine and why.

Prove, Integrate and Go Live

  • Lead proof-of-concept and pilot engagements, configuring Application Programming Interface (API) integrations, building Postman collections and managing sandbox environments,
  • Validate behaviour under realistic conditions and document what the client needs to go live,
  • Guide client developers through API and mobile Software Development Kit (SDK) integration, including webhooks, authentication and testing,
  • Troubleshoot integration issues by reading logs and diagnosing failures at the API and SDK level, rather than only forwarding them,
  • Maintain a living integration map of the client’s architecture, data flows and dependencies,
  • Own the account from signature to go-live, running the go-live plan and handing a documented account to Customer Success and Support at the end of hypercare.

Advise and Enable

  • Build trusted advisor relationships with business and technical stakeholders, from first conversation to go-live,
  • Represent the client’s technical reality internally, feeding integration blockers, product gaps and pilot learnings back to Product and Sales teams,
  • Work with the internal escalation team on deeper platform issues, arriving with clear technical context,
  • Stand alongside Sales in client meetings, addressing objections on integration effort, feasibility and alternatives,
  • Improve demo environments, architecture templates and integration guides, and mentor team members as the practice grows.
 

Preferred Experience

You ask before you propose and qualify before you demo, turning ambiguous client requirements into the right technical solution. You take ownership of the client’s technical path from first conversation to production, and you explain complex systems in plain language to engineers and business leaders alike. You combine hands-on engineering depth with a commercial mindset, and you enjoy working alongside Sales to move a decision forward.

  • Engineering or technical degree, a Master’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience,
  • 3+ years of experience in solutions engineering, technical consulting, or implementation and onboarding in SaaS, ideally in identity, FinTech or security,
  • Discovery and qualification skills, with the ability to turn an ambiguous client requirement into the best technical solution,
  • Solution architecture skills, including designing integration flows, explaining orchestration logic and defending trade-offs with a client’s engineers,
  • Hands-on technical skills with APIs, Software Development Kits (SDKs) including mobile, and integration tooling such as Postman and Git,
  • Experience running a proof of concept and debugging an integration at the API or log level,
  • Delivery discipline to run an integration and onboarding through to a committed go-live date, managing several client projects at once,
  • The ability to translate technical complexity into plain language and reassure non-technical stakeholders,
  • Business value awareness, connecting the technical solution to client outcomes such as verification conversion, fraud loss or time to go-live,
  • Client-facing presence, building trusted advisor relationships with business stakeholders such as Chief Digital Officers (CDOs) and Heads of Digital, and technical stakeholders such as Chief Technology Officers (CTOs), architects and platform engineers,
  • The instinct to own the client’s technical path end to end,
  • Fluent English and full professional French are both hard requirements for the role. Additional European languages are a plus.

 

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with identity verification, Know Your Customer (KYC), Know Your Business (KYB) or Anti-Money Laundering (AML) processes, including document verification, biometrics, liveness detection, eID and fraud detection,
  • Interest in where digital identity is heading, including eIDAS 2.0, EU Digital Identity Wallets, the EU Anti-Money Laundering Regulation and General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR),
  • Experience with mobile SDK delivery on iOS, Android or React Native,
  • Knowledge of web development concepts, including frontend and backend architecture, webhooks and Open Authorisation (OAuth),
  • Experience in mobility, FinTech, banking or other regulated industries,
  • Working knowledge of a programming language such as Python, Java or JavaScript, and of a cloud platform such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

  

Perks & Benefits

  • Health & Wellbeing: Use your full access to the mental health platform nilo, including 1on1 sessions.
  • We value personal and professional development: make full use of Udemy, our training platform with 24/7 access and unlimited content/course consumption incl. certification.
  • We make your remote work comfy: we provide support on equipment and offer flexible working hours.
  • We value collaboration & love to come together: regular onsite gatherings, internal initiatives and summer parties to connect outside of work.
  • May your family require your attention or other reasons apply: use the benefit of our paid special leave days.
  • Enjoy the possibility to combine work with a longer stay at your holiday destination or extend a weekend with our Workcation possibilities.
  • In addition to the perks & benefits above, we offer specific benefits that differ between our locations.

You will focus on enabling the MSSP ecosystem, positioning and integrating SentinelOne's technology within partner technical offerings, selling to the managed partner base, conducting demos, delivering technical training, Proof of Values, assisting partners with pre and post sales activities, and assisting with escalations.   • Plan and create go-to-market initiatives and offerings with SentinelOne partners

  • Deliver demonstrations and work hands-on with partners to demonstrate SentinelOne's value in the partner's environment or solutions.

What skills and knowledge should you bring?

  • 10 Years+ in field, 5+ years Sales Engineering experience
  • Exceptional track record of growing managed partner technical resources
  • Strong background in building relationships with internal sales and product teams
  • Experience presenting and delivering technical demos and sales values presentations to varying audiences from architects to C-level executives.
  • Technical experience/skills for the successful candidate:
  • Experience working with CSPs, channel, MSP/MSSPs, GSIs, or alliances partners.
  • Ability to quickly learn, adapt, understand, and work with new emerging technologies, methodologies and solutions 
  • Fluent Dutch and English
  • Willingness to travel up to 50%

description:
At JetBrains, code is our passion. Ever since we started, back in 2000, we have strived to make the strongest, most effective developer tools on earth. By automating routine checks and corrections, our tools speed up production, freeing developers to grow, discover, and create.

We just unveiled JetBrains Central,  a platform for agent-driven software development that connects tools, agents, and infrastructure. It enables automated AI workflows to run, be monitored, and be managed across teams – with clear visibility into results, costs, and performance.

JetBrains Central provides three core capabilities:
Governance and control: Policy enforcement, identity and access management, observability, auditability, and cost attribution for agent-driven work. Some of these functionalities are already available via the JetBrains Central Console.
Agent execution infrastructure: Cloud agent runtimes and computation provisioning that allow agents to run reliably across development environments.
Agent optimization and context: Shared semantic context across repositories and projects, enabling agents to access relevant knowledge, and task routing to the most appropriate models or tools.

Inside the Professional Services department, we are building a team of Forward Deployed Engineers to help our customers adopt AI-native development with JetBrains Central and enable JetBrains consulting partners to transform their customers’ AI-native software development lifecycle.

About the role

As a Principal Forward Deployed Engineer, you will work directly with early adopter customers to deploy JetBrains Central platform into complex enterprise environments and help them move from experimental AI usage to governed, scalable AI-native development.

You will act as a trusted advisor to customer engineering teams and consulting partners, while also mentoring other Forward Deployed Engineers and helping with complex deployments. In this role, you will help establish best practices for enterprise AI adoption and influence how organizations implement AI-driven software development.

This role is often a strong fit for engineers who have previously served as Principal or Staff Engineers, Heads of Engineering, CTOs, or Solutions Architects and who enjoy working directly with customers while staying deeply involved with complex technical systems.

This role combines consulting, architecture, and hands-on engineering. Your work in the field will directly influence how our platform evolves and how enterprises adopt AI-driven development.

You will work directly with the world’s most innovative companies — our client base includes 420 of the Fortune 500 — ensuring they maximize the value of their JetBrains investments.

What you’ll do

  • Deploy JetBrains Central platform into enterprise development environments, CI/CD systems, and internal developer platforms.
  • Help organizations transition from ad-hoc AI experimentation to governed AI-native development workflows.
  • Implement enterprise AI governance, including security policies, access management, and data privacy controls.
  • Enable observability for AI-driven development to help organizations understand their AI usage and its impact on productivity, as well as their code-generation patterns.
  • Design sustainable AI adoption strategies, including usage controls and cost visibility across multiple model providers.
  • Integrate our cloud-based agent execution layer, allowing AI agents to run securely and at scale.
  • Collaborate closely with JetBrains product teams to shape the platform based on real-world deployments and customer feedback.
  • Create delivery frameworks and train JetBrains partners to deliver the desired scope of service.
  • Mentor and support other Forward Deployed Engineers, sharing architectural expertise and helping to scale the team’s deployment practices.

You will thrive in this role if you are

  • A consultant at heart who can communicate effectively with both engineers and technical leadership.
  • Able to see the whole picture of the software development lifecycle across developer tools, infrastructure, APIs, and cloud systems.
  • Experienced at integrating complex software systems into enterprise environments.
  • Curious about the future of AI agents and AI-native software development.
  • Comfortable working with early adopters and overcoming ambiguous technical challenges.
  • Motivated to mentor other engineers and contribute to building a new technical discipline.

What you will bring

  • Experience in software-related projects, ideally in a customer-facing or consulting environment.
  • Familiarity with Java or Python.
  • Experience building or integrating developer platforms, infrastructure systems, or software solutions.
  • Familiarity with modern development workflows (CI/CD, developer environments, internal developer platforms, etc.).
  • Experience working directly with customers or technical stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to operate in fast-evolving technical environments.
  • Ability and desire to travel to meet customers.

These would be a plus, but are not blockers

  • Experience with industry-specific solutions (fintech, telco, retail, etc.)
  • Experience with AI/LLM platforms, agent frameworks, or AI-assisted development tools.
    Experience in solutions engineering, consulting, or forward-deployed engineering roles.
  • Familiarity with the JetBrains ecosystem or developer productivity tooling.

We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation.

Strong CAD skills in SolidWorks (preferred) or equivalent (e.g. Creo, Onshape), with a good grasp of GD&T. description: 📍 Localisation : Nantes (Ile de Nantes) 📅 Début : ASAP ⏳ Durée : 6 mois 💰 Gratification de stage : conformément au minimum conventionnel en vigueur. Lengow, expert des solutions e-commerce intelligentes Lengow est un acteur de référence des solutions e-commerce intelligentes, qui accompagne les marques et les distributeurs dans leur croissance rentable sur les canaux digitaux. Grâce à ses solutions performantes de gestion de flux produits, de veille tarifaire internationale et d'analyse de données, Lengow propose une suite complète d'outils SaaS permettant aux e-commerçants d'améliorer la visibilité de leurs produits en ligne, de renforcer leur compétitivité grâce à des stratégies de prix éclairées, de développer leurs ventes sur les marketplaces et de suivre la présence de leur marque auprès des distributeurs. Depuis 2009, Lengow accompagne la croissance digitale de plus de 3 600 clients, sur des milliers de canaux marketing et de vente, dans plus de 60 pays. Votre rôle au sein de la Legal Team Dans le cadre de nos activités, nous recherchons un.e stagiaire Juriste en Droit du Numérique & Protection des Données Personnelles pour rejoindre notre Legal Team. Directement rattaché.e à la Head of Legal, vous participerez activement aux projets juridiques de l'entreprise, avec une attention particulière portée à la conformité RGPD, aux évolutions réglementaires du secteur numérique et aux enjeux liés à l'intelligence artificielle. Vous aurez également l'opportunité de collaborer avec différentes équipes internes (Product, Tech, Sales, Marketing, HR, etc.) et de développer une approche pratique et opérationnelle du droit. Vos missions 1. Protection des données personnelles & conformité RGPD Participer au suivi et à l'amélioration de la conformité de Lengow en matière de protection des données personnelles. Contribuer à la mise à jour du registre des activités de traitement des données personnelles, en collaboration avec les différentes équipes internes. Participer à la revue et à la mise à jour de la documentation relative à la protection des données (politiques de confidentialité, DPA, procédures internes, etc.). Accompagner la Legal Team dans l'analyse de questions relatives au RGPD et à la protection des données dans le cadre des projets de l'entreprise. Contribuer à la sensibilisation des équipes internes aux enjeux de protection des données, notamment à travers la préparation et l'animation de courtes formations sur les notions fondamentales du RGPD et les bonnes pratiques à adopter au quotidien. 2. Droit du numérique & Intelligence Artificielle Participer à l'analyse des enjeux juridiques liés aux nouvelles technologies, aux solutions SaaS et à l'intelligence artificielle. Contribuer au suivi des évolutions réglementaires européennes, notamment du Règlement européen sur l'intelligence artificielle (AI Act), et à l'évaluation de leurs impacts potentiels sur les activités de Lengow. Participer aux réflexions et projets internes relatifs à l'utilisation de l'intelligence artificielle et à la mise en place de bonnes pratiques. 3. Contrats commerciaux & accompagnement des équipes Participer à la rédaction et à la revue de contrats commerciaux en français et en anglais (contrats SaaS, accords de confidentialité, contrats fournisseurs, accords de partenariat, etc.). Contribuer à l'analyse des clauses contractuelles, notamment celles relatives à la protection des données, à la confidentialité et à la responsabilité. Accompagner la Head of Legal dans le traitement des demandes juridiques des équipes opérationnelles. Participer à la mise à jour des modèles contractuels et des documents juridiques internes. 4. Veille juridique & projets transverses Assurer une veille juridique et réglementaire sur les évolutions en matière de protection des données personnelles, de droit du numérique et d'intelligence artificielle. Réaliser des recherches juridiques et rédiger des synthèses claires et accessibles pour les équipes internes. Contribuer à des projets transverses visant à améliorer les processus, les outils et la documentation juridique de Lengow. Requirements Le profil que nous recherchons Vous préparez un Master 2 en droit du numérique ou, droit des nouvelles technologies, droit des données personnelles ou droit des affaires, avec un intérêt marqué pour les enjeux numériques ou vous êtes en école d'avocats. Vous disposez de bonnes connaissances du RGPD et des principes fondamentaux de la protection des données personnelles. Vous portez un intérêt particulier aux évolutions réglementaires liées à l'intelligence artificielle, notamment à l'AI Act. Vous possédez de bonnes bases en droit des contrats. Vous avez un bon niveau d'anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral. Vous êtes rigoureux.se, curieux.se, autonome et proactif.ve, avec de bonnes capacités d'analyse et de synthèse.Vous faites preuve de pédagogie pour rendre les sujets juridiques accessibles à des interlocuteurs non juristes et appréciez le travail en équipe. Notre processus de recrutement Un premier échange téléphonique avec notre Head of Legal pour faire connaissance et échanger sur votre parcours et vos motivations. Un entretien pour approfondir les échanges, vous présenter les missions et mieux comprendre vos attentes. Bienvenue chez Lengow ! Si nos attentes sont alignées, nous passons à la signature de votre convention de stage. description:
Company Overview

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Group Overview:  

 

Metrea Management is our global shared service providing support for the Capabilities in areas such as People, Finance, Legal, Strategy, Safety, Security and Information Technology.  
 

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas—including airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special mission aviation, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. Whenever we operate, we build vertically integrated full stacks of capability—designing, building, and operating turnkey solutions that let customers scale capacity while benefiting from continuous cycles of innovation. With operators and engineers under one roof, we close the gap between lab and field—what we call connecting design with effect. Metrea’s solutions are built for elegance: effective, efficient, and evolving. This approach enables our partners to do more with less and achieve outsized, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats. Headquartered in Washington, DC, Metrea has facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, Europe, and beyond. 

 

Position Summary  

At Metrea, we seek out the most complex national security challenges and proactively develop elegant solutions. Those solutions start with our people, and their ability to deliver mission-critical effects around the world.

Our Talent Acquisition team is focused on delivering equally compelling and strategic recruiting solutions to our teammates and business leaders through deep recruiting expertise, a consultative approach, and analytical rigour. In this role, you will partner closely with leaders across Metrea's European Support Groups to deliver high-quality hiring that enables the business to scale. You'll manage a broad portfolio of roles ranging from senior, high-touch searches to operational and specialist hiring, whilst leading a small team.

We're actively investing in our TA function and you'll own meaningful pieces of that build alongside your peers across Support. You will be successful if you are an experienced in-house recruiter who runs searches with sound judgement, knows what exceptional recruiting looks like, and can confidently influence senior stakeholders with clear recommendations and thoughtful challenge. Equally important: you're someone who wants to contribute to how we recruit at Metrea, lead and develop talent, and take ownership of projects that shape the way we work.

 

 

Role and Responsibilities  

  • Lead end-to-end recruitment across Metrea's European Support Groups, managing a mix of operational, specialist, and leadership searches
  • Lead and develop your team member, creating the conditions for good work, providing clarity on expectations, and supporting their growth and capability development
  • Partner with hiring managers and senior stakeholders to shape talent strategies that align with business priorities, managing up effectively and educating on recruiting best practices
  • Tenaciously source and build pipelines, whilst engaging and nurturing relationships with candidates using empathy and transparency, ensuring they're aligned with Metrea's mission and values
  • Guide and consult with stakeholders using market knowledge and insights to ensure the best hiring decisions
  • Own meaningful build projects within the European Support Groups function: developing recruiting frameworks and tooling, building team capability, and using data to influence hiring decisions and talent strategy.
  • Manage multi-step hiring processes across European teams and time zones, ensuring a smooth and high-quality candidate experience
  • Champion Metrea's employer brand across Europe to attract mission-aligned talent, bringing clarity and energy to who we are and why people should join us
  • Collaborate across the TA function to develop and refine our recruiting practices, bringing your perspective and learning from peers working across other parts of the business

 

Skills and Experience  

 

  • In-house recruitment experience in a scaling or fast-changing organisation, managing a broad range of roles at varying levels
  • Proven people leadership experience. You've managed people before and know how to build trust, set clear expectations, and create space for others to grow
  • Track record of knowing what excellence looks like in recruiting and being willing to hold the line on quality and approach
  • Proven ability to consult, partner, and influence at multiple levels—managing up to leadership, laterally with peers, and as a leader to your team
  • Strong familiarity with European talent markets, key talent pools, and industry trends across the region
  • Strong judgement in shaping recruitment approaches and improving processes to deliver high-quality hires
  • Track record of building and maintaining diverse, high-quality candidate pipelines at scale
  • Experience managing multi-step, complex hiring processes across geographically dispersed teams and time zones
  • Ability to balance breadth and depth, adapting to varying role types and business needs
  • Experience with Greenhouse or other applicant tracking systems
  • Familiarity with enterprise support functions including People, Finance, Operations, Legal, and Strategy
  • Ownership mentality. You see problems and want to solve them, and you're energised by having clear ownership of meaningful work

 

Benefits  

  • Private Medical Insurance  
  • Subsided gym membership / plans through Wellhub  
  • Electric Car scheme  
  • Cycle to work scheme  
  • Salary sacrificed pension scheme  
  • Free lunch on office days  
  • Enhanced Parental Leave  
  • 30 days annual PTO plus b/h  

 

Right to Work 

The employee will have the legal right to work in the UK and will be able to produce right to work documentation.  

 

Equal Opportunities Statement  

Metrea Management Limited (MAM) is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or other characteristics protected by law.  

 

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work  

This is a full-time non-exempt position with typical working hours of Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Hours and work shifts may change in accordance with department and business needs. Exempt Employees must have the ability to be on-call and available, as business needs require. Non-Exempt employees may be required to work over 40 hours per week with approval from the department manager.  

 

Work Location  

You will normally be required to work at/ from the Metrea Management Limited offices on The Third Floor, The Aircraft Factory, 100 Cambridge Grove, London, England, W6 0LE 

 

Work Environment  

This job operates in an office setting. Hybrid; minimum of 3 days/ week onsite 

 

Travel  

10% 

Our Firmware

At Metrea, our single core value is Rooted in Humility, and our four cornerstone attributes are Entrepreneurial, Systematic, Discerning, and Over-Deliver. These form what we call our Teammate Firmware. Just like technical firmware connects software and hardware, our Firmware is the constant interface between our mission and our people. It defines how we show up, how we work together, and how we solve complex problems.

Our team Firmware creates a web-like, hyper-collaborative, dynamically hierarchical way of working that helps us adapt quickly, communicate openly, and distribute decision-making to where expertise actually lives. It enables groups to self-organize around hard problems, shift fluidly as priorities evolve, and operate with the trust, curiosity, and discipline required in a complex mission space. This foundation allows us to deliver elegant, effective solutions and uphold our purpose: protecting our precious inheritance.

    • Understanding of the general cybersecurity landscape with respect to threats and challenges
    • Experience with SaaS/PaaS/cloud-based services, driving their adoption, integration, and ongoing use
    • Understanding of software development lifecycle and application builder practices

description: People Business Partner & Total Rewards Most People roles ask you to run processes someone else built. This one asks you to build them, and to own one of them outright: how Eye rewards and recognises its people. You’ll do that while partnering the part of the business where cybersecurity actually happens, with managers who are still learning to lead and specialists who know exactly how rare they are. If you need a mature organization around you to do your best work, this isn’t it. If you get energy from building one, keep reading. The role This role has two halves, and you’ll split your time roughly evenly between them. The first half is Total Rewards. You’ll own compensation and benefits at Eye, including salary reviews, benchmarking, levelling, benefits and our equity program. There’s no finished framework waiting for you. You’ll shape it, make it hold up as we grow, and get us ready for EU pay transparency. You don’t need to be a reward specialist yet. If you owned reward projects before and want to make this your expertise, this is where you do it. The second half is partnering. You’ll be the People Business Partner for our core business: security operations, incident response, customer support & onboarding, and project management. It’s the most varied population in the company: working students running shift rosters next to deeply specialized senior engineers, and managers at very different stages of their leadership journey. That mix is exactly why this role needs presence more than years. You’ll coach a first-time manager on the basics one hour and align a salary band with C-level the next. You’ll need to be comfortable doing both, and to enjoy it. What you’ll do Own Total Rewards end to end: run the annual salary review, keep our benchmarks honest, and build levelling and salary bands that make sense to managers and employees alike. Manage benefits: run our benefits across the Netherlands, the UK, Germany and Belgium, work with providers, and keep improving what actually matters to our people. Manage our equity program: grants, refreshers, and making sure people understand what their equity means. Prepare Eye for pay transparency: work with Legal and Finance so we’re ready for the EU directive, not scrambling to catch up. Be the trusted partner for leaders in security operations and customer support: coaching, challenging and advising at every level of maturity, up to and including the executive team. Be visible. This is an office where face-to-face matters: you’ll be on the floor in The Hague, listening to what’s actually going on, not partnering from a distance. Handle the real side of employee relations: sick leave and reintegration, conduct issues and complex cases, working with external counsel when needed. You’ve seen the challenging cases and you don’t flinch. Work as part of a small, tight People team: everyone picks things up, and so will you. What we’re looking for HRBP experience in a scaling tech environment. You know what good looks like at 200+ people. Hands-on reward experience. Around a year in a reward or C&B role, or several reward projects you led yourself: salary reviews, benchmarking, levelling or benefits. Specialist depth is not required; curiosity to build it is. Comfortable with numbers. You can build a comp analysis in a spreadsheet and explain it to a manager who has never seen one. Strong stakeholder management and the presence to challenge back, including senior leadership, without becoming the policy police. Genuinely comfortable with ambiguity. Our problems don’t come with a manual, and you’d rather solve them creatively than wait for one. Hands-on, working knowledge of Dutch labor law, and you know when to bring in an expert. Professional English. Dutch is a plus, not a requirement. Based in the Netherlands and happy coming into the office: at least 1 day a week in The Hague, ideally 3. What we offer Real impact: help build the People foundations of a company protecting businesses across Europe, alongside colleagues from intelligence, military, tech and consulting backgrounds. A clear path to make Total Rewards your specialism, with direct exposure to the leadership team. Thursday borrels and regular team socials to catch up in person. Quarterly get-togethers and an annual company-wide retreat (Spain, Portugal, Italy…). Generous time off, including wellbeing days, floating holidays and a volunteering day. Competitive base salary and company equity. MacBook Pro or Dell XPS, plus iPhone or Samsung. description:
Headquartered in Silicon Valley, California, Archer is a leader in the next-gen aerospace sector building an end-to-end advanced air mobility platform that delivers air taxis, unmanned aircraft systems (“UAS”), aviation-related physical artificial intelligence (“AI”) solutions, and other technologies to customers worldwide across the commercial aerospace and defense sectors.

Our sights are set high and our problems are hard, and we believe that diversity in the workplace is what makes us smarter, drives better insights, and will ultimately lift us all to success. We are dedicated to cultivating an equitable and inclusive environment that embraces our differences, and supports and celebrates all of our team members.

Archer is best known for Midnight, our electric air taxi. This role isn't on that program. The AI Products Org is building consumer software for people who love to fly: mobile apps, websites, and web apps for flyers, flight enthusiasts, and pilots. We haven't announced what we're building, and we're not going to spoil it in a job posting. What we can tell you: it's a consumer app with a large user base, and the design decisions made in the next year will define the next chapter of growth for the product.

That's why we're hiring a UX Product Designer; specifically, someone who has shipped consumer apps that real people download, rate, and decide to keep or delete, and who can take a loosely defined problem and come back with something worth building.

What You'll Do:

  • End-to-end product design for consumer aviation apps on iOS and Android, along with the websites and web apps that support them
  • Design for a wide range of users, from casual flyers and aviation enthusiasts to working pilots who need information that's fast, accurate, and trustworthy
  • Run product explorations: sketch out directions, pressure-test them with users and the team, and kill the weak ones early
  • You'll get context and constraints from Design Leadership, PM and engineering, but the design leadership on your projects is yours
  • Ship to the App Store and Google Play, then keep refining based on how people actually use what you shipped: analytics, experiments, reviews, and user research
  • Raise the bar on craft across the org, through your own work and through feedback on everyone else's

What You Need:

  • 5+ years of product design experience minimum. 
  • A track record of shipping features for consumer mobile apps on the App Store and Google Play, ideally at a startup, a big tech company, or both
  • Products you've designed that are live and in users' hands. We will ask about them, in detail: what you decided, what you got wrong, what you'd change
  • Deep fluency in native iOS and Android design (Human Interface Guidelines, Material Design) and strong systems thinking across mobile and web. You know when a pattern should be shared across platforms and when it shouldn't
  • Experience using data to shape design decisions, from engagement and retention metrics to App Store feedback
  • Comfort with ambiguity. If you need a fully scoped ticket before you can start, this won't be a fit
  • A portfolio that shows your thinking, not just polished final screens

Bonus Qualifications:

  • You're a pilot, student pilot, plane spotter, or all-around aviation nerd. You'd be designing for people like you, and that matters
  • Experience designing consumer apps built around real-time data, maps, or location
  • Experience growing a consumer app: onboarding, retention, subscriptions, or monetization, social posting and marketing collateral
  • Experience working alongside AI/ML teams, or designing products with AI-driven features
  • You've shipped consumer products in a domain with real-world constraints (regulated industries, safety-adjacent, hardware-adjacent) and know how that shapes design

About The Team:

AI Products is a roughly 100-person software org inside a company of aerospace engineers, and we expect to grow substantially over the next year. You get the resources and momentum of a real org, but the product development startup culture of a smaller team based in the UK – building for an audience that genuinely cares about flying.

If you want to hear more about what we're building before you apply, you can't. Apply, and we'll tell you plenty.

As a Working Student in our Academics team, you will support the day-to-day operations and growth of thinkcell’s academic program. You will work on a broad range of tasks, from handling program requests and supporting outreach to coordinating workshops and improving processes.

Our academic program gives students and professors free access to thinkcell and helps them develop practical skills in data visualization and storytelling. You will help us bring these opportunities to more universities, faculty members, and student clubs worldwide (find out more here). We have big plans to grow the program significantly with the next years – and you can be apart of it.

  • Contribute across the team: Support ongoing projects and ad hoc tasks, taking ownership of defined activities as you gain experience

  • Studies: Currently enrolled in business, computer science, or a related field, with at least two years of university studies completed – undergraduate degree is a plus
  • Mindset & Skills: Proactive and comfortable working independently, with strong problem-solving skills and a keen eye for detail. Well organized, reliable, and able to prioritize tasks
  • Microsoft Office: Proficient in Microsoft Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint

Our Values 

As part of our team, you will embody and help shape the following principles that define us:  

Forward Thinking: We embrace change and challenge the status quo. 

Ownership: We take pride in our work and learn from our mistakes.

Why is thinkcell the right place for you? 

We empower over 1.3 million users across 35,000 companies, including top consulting firms and major global enterprises. With offices in Berlin, Munich, Denver, Boston, London, Tokyo, and Dubai, we’re a diverse team of over 240 people, committed to innovation and excellence.

thinkcell is more than a job – it's a chance to be part of an innovative, inclusive team that values collaboration and growth. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply. Together, we can shape the future of productivity software. We can’t wait to see what you’ll bring to the team!

Establish protocols to handle data, safeguard sensitive information, and optimize data usage within the organization. Design and advise on data quality rules and set up effective data compliance policies. Must have skills : Graph Databases Good to have skills : Neo4j, Python Frameworks Minimum 5 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary: As a Data Management Practitioner, a typical day involves overseeing the stewardship of an organization's data assets to ensure they meet quality and compliance standards. This role includes designing and implementing comprehensive data strategies that uphold data integrity and enforce governance policies. The practitioner establishes and maintains protocols for managing data securely, protecting sensitive information, and optimizing the use of data across various departments. Additionally, they provide guidance on data quality standards and develop effective compliance policies to support organizational objectives and regulatory requirements. Roles & Responsibilities: - Design and implement scalable ETL and ELT pipelines to ingest, transform, and load structured and unstructured data into graph databases. - Build and maintain knowledge graph infrastructure on platforms such as Neo4j, Stardog, Amazon Neptune, Stardog, or Apache Jena — including indexing, query optimization, and availability tuning. - Write and optimize complex SPARQL, Cypher, and Gremlin queries for production graph workloads including traversal, inference, and aggregation. - Implement SHACL or ShEx constraints and automated validation pipelines to enforce data conformance against ontology schemas. - Develop APIs and microservices that expose graph data to downstream consumers — including search, recommendation, and LLM/RAG pipelines. - Integrate knowledge graph layers with vector databases and embedding models to support hybrid semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation. - Collaborate with ontology designers to implement and version ontology changes safely in production without disrupting dependent services. - Monitor graph platform performance, diagnose bottlenecks, and drive reliability improvements across ingestion and query layers. - Conduct code reviews, define engineering standards, and mentor mid-level and junior developers on graph engineering best practices. - Contribute to documentation, runbooks, and internal tooling to support the broader knowledge graph team's productivity. - Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform. - Responsible for team decisions. - Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions. - Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams. - Lead initiatives to improve data governance frameworks and ensure alignment with organizational goals. - Facilitate communication and coordination between cross-functional teams to promote data quality and compliance. - Mentor junior team members to support their professional growth and enhance team capabilities. Professional & Technical Skills: - Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Graph Databases, Neo4j, Python Frameworks. - Good To Have Skills: Experience with Neo4j, Python Frameworks. - Strong knowledge of data modeling and schema design specific to graph database technologies. - Ability to develop and optimize queries for efficient data retrieval and manipulation within graph databases. - Experience in implementing data governance policies and ensuring compliance with data protection regulations. - Familiarity with integrating graph databases into broader data ecosystems and workflows. Additional Information: - The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Graph Databases. - This position is based at our Bhubaneswar office. title: Data Management Practitioner

description: Project Role : Data Management Practitioner Project Role Description : Maintain the quality and compliance of an organizations data assets. Design and implement data strategies, ensuring data integrity and enforcing governance policies. Establish protocols to handle data, safeguard sensitive information, and optimize data usage within the organization. Design and advise on data quality rules and set up effective data compliance policies. Must have skills : Graph Databases Good to have skills : Neo4j, Python Frameworks Minimum 5 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary: As a Data Management Practitioner, a typical day involves overseeing the stewardship of an organization's data assets to ensure they meet quality and compliance standards. This role includes designing and implementing comprehensive data strategies that uphold data integrity and enforce governance policies. The practitioner establishes and maintains protocols for managing data securely, protecting sensitive information, and optimizing the use of data across various departments. Additionally, they provide guidance on data quality standards and develop effective compliance policies to support organizational objectives and regulatory requirements. Roles & Responsibilities: - Design and implement scalable ETL and ELT pipelines to ingest, transform, and load structured and unstructured data into graph databases. - Build and maintain knowledge graph infrastructure on platforms such as Neo4j, Stardog, Amazon Neptune, Stardog, or Apache Jena — including indexing, query optimization, and availability tuning. - Write and optimize complex SPARQL, Cypher, and Gremlin queries for production graph workloads including traversal, inference, and aggregation. - Implement SHACL or ShEx constraints and automated validation pipelines to enforce data conformance against ontology schemas. - Develop APIs and microservices that expose graph data to downstream consumers — including search, recommendation, and LLM/RAG pipelines. - Integrate knowledge graph layers with vector databases and embedding models to support hybrid semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation. - Collaborate with ontology designers to implement and version ontology changes safely in production without disrupting dependent services. - Monitor graph platform performance, diagnose bottlenecks, and drive reliability improvements across ingestion and query layers. - Conduct code reviews, define engineering standards, and mentor mid-level and junior developers on graph engineering best practices. - Contribute to documentation, runbooks, and internal tooling to support the broader knowledge graph team's productivity. - Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform. - Responsible for team decisions. - Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions. - Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams. - Lead initiatives to improve data governance frameworks and ensure alignment with organizational goals. - Facilitate communication and coordination between cross-functional teams to promote data quality and compliance. - Mentor junior team members to support their professional growth and enhance team capabilities. Professional & Technical Skills: - Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Graph Databases, Neo4j, Python Frameworks. - Good To Have Skills: Experience with Neo4j, Python Frameworks. - Strong knowledge of data modeling and schema design specific to graph database technologies. - Ability to develop and optimize queries for efficient data retrieval and manipulation within graph databases. - Experience in implementing data governance policies and ensuring compliance with data protection regulations. - Familiarity with integrating graph databases into broader data ecosystems and workflows. Additional Information: - The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Graph Databases. - This position is based at our Bhubaneswar office. Education: - A 15 years full time education is required. 15 years full time education About Accenture Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. description: Project Role : Knowledge Engineer Project Role Description : Design and structure knowledge frameworks that enable AI systems to reason and make informed decisions. Must have skills : AWS BigData Good to have skills : Data Engineering, Graph Databases, Neo4j Minimum 5 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Role Summary / Description AI Powered Tech Talent Engineer role in Knowledge Engineering for a strong individual contributor who helps build scalable Knowledge Graph, semantic layer, ontology, and AI-enabled data solutions using Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role you will work hands-on across the knowledge graph lifecycle from ingestion through modeling, curation, implementation, integration, and deployment. The role applies current methodologies, generative AI, LLM, multimodal, graph, search, and semantic techniques to practical business problems while collaborating with users, use case representatives, engineers, architects, UI designers, and delivery teams. The role must include industry experience or project exposure in domains such as banking, insurance, healthcare, retail, telecom, manufacturing, energy, public sector, or life sciences. Key Responsibilities Build AWS-based knowledge engineering components using Amazon Neptune, S3, Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, OpenSearch, SageMaker, Bedrock, IAM, CloudWatch, APIs, and other relevant AWS services. Implement graph ingestion, ontology/schema pipelines, semantic data products, vector and search integrations, LLM grounding layers, and governed access patterns on AWS. Build Knowledge Graph components that contribute to transforming a client's data architecture. Design, develop, configure, test, and implement AI and semantic solutions that integrate clearly with the broader enterprise system. Work alongside project teams, delivery leads, engineers, architects, users, use case representatives, and UI designers to deliver assigned components of an end-to-end solution. Build solid working relationships with client counterparts on the workstream and communicate implementation progress, risks, dependencies, and technical findings clearly. Help assemble supporting evidence for recommended semantic layer solutions, including design rationale, implementation notes, validation inputs, data quality observations, and test outcomes. Keep developing skills in cutting-edge Data and AI solutions, especially agentic technologies, generative AI, LLMs, multimodal models, semantic search, graph RAG, and knowledge graph approaches. Design neural network parameters, trained on large quantities of unlabeled text data. Must have skills : Snowflake Data Warehouse Good to have skills : Data Science, Microsoft Azure Data Services Minimum 5 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary: AI Powered Tech Talent You are a a strong individual contributor knowledge engineer growing into a team lead. You are well versed in the full knowledge graph development lifecycle. You formulate real-world problems into practical, efficient, scalable AI and Knowledge Graph solutions, working hands-on across the lifecycle from ingestion through modeling, curation, and deployment. You apply current methodologies, techniques, and algorithms with the right architecture, and begin to guide junior engineers on the project. You stay current with knowledge engineering, generative AI, LLM, and multi-modal models look for opportunities to apply them to the problem at hand. You design, evaluate, and maintain ontologies as needed. You help articulate the value of generative AI and knowledge graph approaches for a given business problem. You share what they learn with the team. You collaborate with users, use case reps, engineers, architects, and UI designers to deliver their piece of an end-to-end solution. Build Knowledge Graph components that contribute to transforming a client's data architecture. Design, develop, and implement AI and semantic solutions ensure their work integrates cleanly with the broader system. Work alongside the project team and delivery leads. Build solid working relationships with client counterparts on their workstream. Help assemble the supporting evidence for the recommended semantic layer solution. Support Accenture sales efforts when called on. Keep developing skills in cutting-edge Data & AI solutions, especially agentic technologies, and shares with the team. Bachelor's degree or equivalent Bachelor's degree or equivalent, plus at least 3 of the following: Minimum 2 years of experience with Knowledge Graph technologies (RDF, SPARQL, LPG, SHACL) Minimum 2 years of experience in schema design, ontology management, and KG curation Minimum 2 years of designing and developing KG solutions and graph-based ML models (functional + technical) Minimum 1 year of experience with end-to-end data pipeline implementation for AI applications (esp. LLMs), with hands-on design and configuration Minimum 2 years of experience with strong knowledge of relational databases, object stores, graph databases (Stardog, Neo4J, Amazon Neptune), and vector databases (no leadership/commercial requirement at this band) 2+ years of hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) 2+ years of experience in Python, with experience in frameworks like Tensorflow, PyTorch, and tools for building ETL pipelines (e.g. Apache NiFi, Airflow) Practical experience with NLP and/or Search techniques Prompt engineering, and LLMs for enterprise-scale applications. You have team lead experience Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work across engineering, research, and product teams across multiple time zones. You have external client-facing consulting experience Broad experience in diverse ML techniques and agentic systems As a Large Language Model Architect, your day involves designing and structuring advanced language models capable of understanding and generating human-like text. You will focus on creating neural network configurations that efficiently process vast amounts of unstructured text data. Your role includes envisioning scalable architectures that support the training and deployment of these models, ensuring they meet performance and accuracy requirements. Collaboration with various teams to align model capabilities with project goals and continuous refinement of model parameters to enhance language comprehension and generation are key aspects of your daily activities. Roles & Responsibilities: - Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform. - Responsible for team decisions. - Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions. - Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams. - Lead the development and implementation of architectural strategies for large language models. - Facilitate knowledge sharing and mentorship within the team to foster professional growth. - Coordinate cross-functional efforts to ensure seamless integration of language models into broader systems. Professional & Technical Skills: - Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Snowflake Data Warehouse. - Good To Have Skills: Experience with Microsoft Azure Data Services, Data Science. - Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts and cloud-based data storage solutions. - Experience in designing scalable data architectures to support machine learning workloads. - Familiarity with data processing pipelines and optimization techniques for large datasets. - Ability to analyze and troubleshoot complex data integration and performance issues. Additional Information: - The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Snowflake Data Warehouse. - This position is based at our Bengaluru office. - A 15 years full time education is required. 15 years full time education About Accenture Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. You Are: We are looking for a Back-End Engineer to design, build, and operate the data infrastructure and services that power our AI-driven knowledge platform. Collaborate with ontologists, architects, and application teams to support Knowledge Graph implementations. Minimum 5 years experience deploying and operating vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, or Qdrant) in production environments. Minimum 5 years Proficiency in Python or Java for automation, integration, and service development and experience designing and documenting REST APIs for internal consumers. Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience Bonus Points if You Have: Familiarity with containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes). Knowledge of data ingestion pipelines, ETL/integration, and enterprise system integration. Understanding of PII/PHI handling, data anonymization, and data governance. Design and build user-facing applications and dashboards that surface Knowledge Graph data to end users. Develop and maintain REST and GraphQL APIs bridging graph backends and frontend clients. You Are You are a Knowledge Architect at the intersection of semantic AI and agentic systems — shaping the knowledge backbone of AI platforms by designing the ontologies, graphs, and data models that enable intelligent agents to reason, plan, and act. You are equally comfortable whiteboarding an ontology with a domain expert and pushing graph schemas to production alongside an ML team. You see the world as a graph, and you believe that well-structured knowledge is the foundation of truly intelligent machines. Communicate complex ontological concepts and graph architectures clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Evaluate and pilot emerging tools, frameworks, and standards (e.g., LPG vs. RDF, Wikidata, schema.org, W3C standards). description: About the Centre for Advanced Data APAC The Centre for Advanced Data (C4AD) is Accenture's specialist centre of excellence that sets the architecture standard for modern, AI-ready data estates across APAC, and mobilises the talent to deliver them at scale. The C4AD operates across three core disciplines: Master Data Architecture, Knowledge Engineering, and Data Products. Every practitioner in the C4AD is expected to apply agentic and generative techniques as the default way of working, not as an add-on. The centre supports large-scale data and AI transformation programmes across the region, ranging from enterprise data modernisation to AI-ready platform builds. Job Description Join the Centre for Advanced Data APAC as a Knowledge Engineer, where you will own ontology and semantic strategy across engagements, set the knowledge-engineering standards for the practice, and assure the semantic layers that ground enterprise AI. You will define how the C4AD approaches knowledge representation across programmes, and hold the line on quality, consistency, and semantic integrity as those programmes scale. You will work closely with Data Architects and AI Engineers, ensuring that the ontologies and knowledge graphs you define and govern give AI systems something real, structured, and reliable to reason over. Project Description / Key Responsibilities Own ontology and semantic strategy across C4AD engagements, setting the approach, standards, and quality bar for knowledge engineering across the practice. Assure semantic layers that ground enterprise AI, reviewing, governing, and signing off on the ontological structures that AI systems in our programmes reason over. Design, develop, and govern enterprise ontologies, taxonomies, and knowledge graphs that accurately represent business domains, their relationships, and the rules that govern them. Build and govern semantic models using RDF/OWL, SHACL, and SPARQL, and property graph approaches using platforms such as Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, or Stardog. Enable AI and ML applications through knowledge graph enrichment, entity resolution, semantic search, and ontology-powered RAG pipelines. Experience with entity resolution, semantic search, and knowledge-driven RAG architectures.
